description: Use this when the user asks how many products are submitted, launched or declined on uneed.best per month, or wants launch-volume trends (for example to tell more people submitting products apart from stricter curation). Returns one row per month since 2024-02 with `launched`, plus `submitted` and `declined` from 2026-08, each with `complete` (false for the current month) and `estimated`. The answer carries the definitions of every field and the license (CC BY 4.0, attribution "Source: Uneed, uneed.best"): quote them when you reuse the figures. For the products themselves use get_recent_launches or get_trending.
name: get_launch_stats
title: Get monthly launch statistics
